notes.model: MoE vision-language model (~31B stored, ~3B active). Not text-only Qwen3-30B.
notes.activation_layers: Eight evenly spaced language blocks from ~1/8 depth through the last of 48.
notes.compute_canada: Download on a login node into $SCRATCH/huggingface then run the GPU job with HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1. BF16 needs ~80 GB VRAM (A100/H100 80GB). On 40 GB use --quant nf4.
